sections.html: Have you been feeling foggy or low energy? Do you need to detox your spirit of negativity? Are you around or on technology all day long? Then it’s time to bring healing shungite crystals into your stone collection.

Touted as the Miracle Stone of the 21st Century,  Shungite is now the go-to stone for electromagnetic field (EMF) protection, purification and detoxification of the body, as well as general healing and emotional well being. But what is Shungite, exactly? And what are the benefits of Shungite? While not a crystal, it is one of the strongest mineral healers because the Shungite properties span the board from purity to protection, offering a variety of benefits to anyone who works with this powerful stone. Although the most popular use of the Shungite stone is for electronics, the healing potential of this stone goes far beyond protection from technology and can be used as part of crystal body layouts, crystal elixirs, meditations, and more.

Shungite has been around for an estimated two billion years, but what is shungite and its healing potential was recognized through the 1996 Nobel Prize-winning research that discovered fullerenes within the stone. Shungite is composed mostly of pure carbon and is the only known natural mineral to contain fullerenes, which are specific molecular formations of carbon that act as powerful, long-lasting antioxidants. 

Although this scientific breakthrough happened in more recent years, Shungite had been known to purify water long compressed charcoal or carbon blocks in water filters were used to do the same. In Russia, the only place in the world where this stone is found, springs that pass over Shungite rocks were turned into natural spas in the time of Peter the Great. It was known then, just as it is now, that Shungite works most powerfully when used in conjunction with water.

Shungite is found only in Karelia, Russia

The Shungite meaning ranges from spiritual and emotional purification to protection, which makes it one of the most adaptable and powerful stones out there. Whether you’re looking for an energetic shield to minimize the effects of EMFs and technology, or you’re looking for an emotional detox from heavy energy, this carbon-based stone holds the energy you need to support your intention.

The Shungite meaning is known to aid in the inhibiting of EMFs, or electromagnetic fields, that are the result of electromagnetic radiation. Electromagnetic fields are created by electronic devices. Common electronic items such as laptops, cell phones, computers and tablets all put out EMFs. Placing this stone at the base of a computer, microwave or around your various home electronic devices will not interfere with their operations, but will block out some of their free radial output. When placed near your devices, or on your body, the Shungite properties work to harmonize these harmful frequencies, protecting and shielding your spirit from their effects. This is one of the most popular uses for the Shungite stone, and for good reason since everyone living in the 21st century is constantly surrounded by electronics and technology.

sections.t: How to Use your Shungite Stone for EMF Protection
sections.html:
Our favorite way to use the Shungite meaning for EMF protection is to create a crystal program for yourself. By wearing Shungite jewelry, carrying the stone, and incorporating it into your space, you minimize and harmonize the effects of EMFs in your home and on-the-go.

Wear

Wearing Shungite jewelry is a powerful way to protect against EMFs because it ensures you never leave the house without your protective shield. Your shungite bracelet, shungite necklace, or shungite earrings can create an energetic barrier and harmonize the frequencies emitted by technology and electronics all around you for constant protection.  

Carry

In addition to wearing the stone, carrying it in your purse or pocket allows you to add an extra layer of protective and grounding energy to your energetic armor. Use a shungite for your cell phone plate to place it directly on your phone while on-the-go. Whether you’re traveling, driving, out-and-about or at work, you’ll have access to the powerful Shungite properties whenever you need them most. 

Place

The last step in your program for EMF protection is to bring the stone into your environment. Place a shungite pyramid on top of electronics and tech devices (laptops, desktops, routers, tablets, etc) to harmonize the frequencies the devices emit into your environment. You can also place it in the four corners of a room, like your office or living room, to seal the room with its grounding and protective energy.

Shungite Stone Intention for EMF Protection

When working with Shungite for EMF protection, use the following intention: I am protected and shielded from the EMFs around me.

sections.t: How to Use your Shungite Stone for Detoxification
sections.html:
To detox your mind, body and spirit, create a Shungite program for yourself that includes wearing it, carrying it, and placing it in your space. 

Wear

For constant access to the detoxifying and purifying energy of this stone, you can wear it in the form of an elite shungite necklace. As soon as it comes into contact with your skin, the stone will help you release any energy that doesn’t serve you, flushing it out of your system. It is often recommended to wear it cautiously at first, as the properties and effects of wearing this stone can be quite intense and powerful, especially for someone new to it.  

Carry

To enhance your detoxification process, keep a piece of this stone in your purse or pocket to cleanse your mind, body and spirit of negative energy throughout the day. 

Place

To complete your practice, place the stone in your space. For detoxification, we suggest placing somewhere prominent you will see it every day as a reminder to cleanse your energy on a daily basis.  

Shungite Stone Intention for Detoxification

When working with Shungite for detoxification, use the following crystal intention: I detoxify my mind, body, and spirit.
